en.intro: This is go-link. Arcade nights, online.
en.home: Your arcade runs on your own computer. Your games never leave your disk.
en.friends: Friends join from the browser. Nothing to install: a code, a PIN, and they're in.
en.invite: Invite them with a link, a code, or a QR. One PIN, one person.
en.controls: Real controllers for up to four players, with voice chat.
en.phone: On a phone, it turns into a console.
en.maker: With Willy Maker, you can even make your own arcade game, and play it in a room.
en.metrics: Every millisecond is measured, so you always know how the game is running.
en.end: go-link. Free and open source. Play together, from anywhere.
